description: If expected_margin_pct is below the applicable policy's min_margin_pct, the deal is out of policy and a pricing exception is required.
If expected_margin_pct is greater than or equal to the applicable policy's min_margin_pct, the deal is compliant with the pricing policy.

If the proposed relationship discount exceeds the policy discount threshold that requires approval, senior approval is required. If it exceeds the product's hard maximum discount allowed, executive approval is required instead.

A pricing policy is applicable to a deal only when a policy exists for the deal's (customer_segment, product_type, risk_category) combination and that policy's status is Active. NOTE: the current pricing_policy.csv source has no effective_date/expiry_date columns, so date-based applicability (as originally specified) cannot be evaluated from available data. This is documented as a business clarification required (see README "Known assumptions"). When effective/expiry dates become available, this rule should be extended to also check: policy_effective_date <= deal_date <= policy_expiry_date (or expiry null).
If expected_margin_pct is null/missing, the compliance rule must return NOT_EVALUATED. It must never default to COMPLIANT or EXCEPTION_REQUIRED.
